open_points.subject: identify_service
open_points.text: identify_service: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST compare the UTF-8 bytes of presented_token through equal_in_constant_time with the bytes of every token give_service_tokens answers, asking for them at this call and keeping none, and answer an IdentifiedService of the service whose token is equal.
open_points.other_text: identify_service: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer a Refusal with the UNAUTHENTICATED member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_AUTHENTICATION constant names and one failure of the NO_VALID_TOKEN member of = models.RefusalKind with an empty path when presented_token is None or equals no token, an unknown token answered as a wrong one, without any count or limit.
open_points.question: Must the constant-time comparisons apply only when presented_token is not None, or must None be represented as bytes and compared before refusal?

open_points.subject: highest_class_of_service
open_points.text: highest_class_of_service: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that highest_class_of_service answers the BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL member of = models.DisclosureClass for the CABINET_KERNEL member of = models.ServiceName, as the imported SERVICE_HIGHEST_CLASSES constant of this release holds.
open_points.rule: Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено, и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой. Таблица — это когда по члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код, категория. Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: The note must refer only to the imported SERVICE_HIGHEST_CLASSES constant and must not state the CABINET_KERNEL-to-BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL mapping inline.

open_points.subject: highest_class_of_service
open_points.text: highest_class_of_service: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that highest_class_of_service answers the BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL member of = models.DisclosureClass for the CABINET_KERNEL member of = models.ServiceName, as the imported SERVICE_HIGHEST_CLASSES constant of this release holds.
open_points.rule:
**Модель не видит значений.** В контекст модуля подаётся сигнатура доступа —
  имя модуля-носителя, имя символа и его тип, — но не значение.
open_points.question: The note must omit the release-specific value held by SERVICE_HIGHEST_CLASSES and expose only the imported symbol and its type.

open_points.subject: service_may_call
open_points.text: service_may_call: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that service_may_call answers may_call true exactly for the rows of the imported SERVICE_RIGHTS constant: false for the CABINET member and the read of a customer's billing data, false for the PRESUPRO member and the publish of an artifact pointer, false for the CABINET_KERNEL member and the read of a project's context, true for the CLIENT_PORTAL member and that read.

open_points.subject: service_may_call
open_points.text: service_may_call: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that service_may_call answers may_call true exactly for the rows of the imported SERVICE_RIGHTS constant: false for the CABINET member and the read of a customer's billing data, false for the PRESUPRO member and the publish of an artifact pointer, false for the CABINET_KERNEL member and the read of a project's context, true for the CLIENT_PORTAL member and that read.
